shortdesc.ph: Represents the codec capabilities of the SDK.
The codec capability of the SDK.

plentry.pd: Bitmask of codec types in the SDK. See .

Video codec type:
1: VP8.
2: H.264.
3: (Default) H.265.

Bitmask of codec types:
(0): Device does not support encoding or decoding.
(1 << 0): Device supports hardware decoding.
(1 << 1): Device supports hardware encoding.
(1 << 2): Device supports software decoding.
(1 << 3): Device supports software encoding.

plentry.pd: Bitmask of the codec capabilities in the SDK. See . For H.265, use this field to check whether the device supports H.265 hardware encoding or hardware decoding.

pd.p:
The bit mask of the codec type:
(0): The device does not support encoding or decoding.
(1 << 0): The device supports hardware decoding. When codecType is AgoraVideoCodecTypeH265, this value indicates support for H.265 hardware decoding.
(1 << 1): The device supports hardware encoding. When codecType is AgoraVideoCodecTypeH265, this value indicates support for H.265 hardware encoding.
(1 << 2): The device supports software decoding.
(1 << 3): The device supports software ecoding.
